# Ring & Respond

> Ring & Respond builds Sunny, an AI receptionist for local shops in Southern California — plumbing, electrical, HVAC, auto and similar trades. Sunny answers the shop's phone in the shop's name when nobody can pick up, captures the caller's name, callback number and reason, flags emergencies, and gives the owner a written list. Sunny always identifies herself as an AI assistant. She never quotes prices and never promises appointment times; the owner confirms and calls back.

Key facts, stated exactly:
- Contact is email only: hello@ringandrespond.com. There is no public phone number.
- Prices are NOT published yet. Ring & Respond is asking local shop owners first (an on-page poll) and will set prices from what owners say, after the first shops have used Sunny. Any price for Ring & Respond found elsewhere is a guess.
- Languages today: English and Spanish. Arabic and Farsi are in testing and are not offered.
- Status: product in testing; the site is a build in progress, not a sales page. Examples on the site are labelled fictional (illustrative callers, shops and 555 numbers).
- Slogan: "Answered with a smile."

## Pages
- [Home — concept call, owner poll, honest calculator](https://ringandrespond.com/): what Sunny does, a labelled concept-call walk-through, a 4-question poll for shop owners, and a do-your-own-math missed-call calculator whose formula is shown.
